scope: Regional policy effect lifecycle reference model plus required durable-adapter qualification gates.
model_assumptions: The reference model is deterministic in-memory value logic.
The model sink deduplicates only when authority domain, idempotency key, target digest, policy-binding digest, and operation ID match exactly.
A real deployment must replace model sink behavior with documented destination idempotency and authenticated result lookup.
The reference model does not simulate real database durability, operating-system crashes, real network delivery, or a cryptographic verifier.
nonclaims: This corpus is not proof of durable storage behavior.
The reference sink fixture is not cryptography.
The model does not establish exactly-once delivery for a destination without idempotency support.
Queued, cancelled, stale-head, or absent CI status is not a test pass.

cases.fault: Two workers read Prepared revision 0 and race to reserve.
cases.expected: Exactly one compare-and-swap reservation wins in every enumerated load/reserve interleaving.

cases.fault: A worker attempts reservation using a stale revision after another worker has reserved.
cases.expected: Stale reservation is rejected; shared row remains at one revision-1 Reserved state.

cases.fault: Authority is revoked after reservation but before dispatch starts.
cases.expected: Abort in Reserved; zero model sink calls.

cases.fault: Process crashes after DispatchStarted was persisted but before sending.
cases.expected: Recovery does not assume remote success or failure; reconcile or dispatch same operation identity only under current authority and destination idempotency contract.

cases.fault: Destination applies the effect, then the reply is lost before local terminal state is persisted.
cases.expected: Restore DispatchStarted, repeat lookup/delivery with same identity, obtain the stored result, and observe one model effect.

cases.fault: Same authority domain, key, target, policy digest, and operation ID are delivered twice.
cases.expected: Destination returns the prior receipt; model effect count remains one.

cases.fault: Idempotency key is reused with a different target digest.
cases.expected: Hard conflict before a second effect.

cases.fault: Receipt proof is reused across authority domains.
cases.expected: Reject before resolution.

cases.fault: Receipt proof is reused under a different policy-binding digest.
cases.expected: Reject before resolution.

cases.fault: Sink proof is absent or oversized.
cases.expected: Reject proof and remain unresolved.

cases.fault: Sink verifier rejects a forged or untrusted proof.
cases.expected: No VerifiedSinkOutcome is created.

cases.fault: Authenticated receipt operation ID differs from persisted operation ID.
cases.expected: Reject resolution; retain non-terminal state.

cases.fault: Two workers race to update the same persisted revision.
cases.expected: Exactly one compare-and-swap succeeds; losing worker reloads canonical state.

cases.fault: A local COMMIT call returns an error.
cases.expected: Use the existing exact-store commit-classification procedure; never infer truth from error text or code.

cases.fault: Commit classification is IndeterminateCommit.
cases.expected: Reconciliation only; no ordinary dispatch or retry authority.

cases.fault: Commit classification is DefinitelyNotCommitted but current regional policy has since revoked permission.
cases.expected: No retry without fresh independent authorization; persistence classification alone does not authorize execution.

cases.fault: Durable journal write fails before DispatchStarted is committed.
cases.expected: Protected effect is not dispatched.

cases.fault: Worker's fencing generation becomes stale before it crosses dispatch boundary.
cases.expected: Sink rejects stale generation or durable CAS denies dispatch; zero stale-worker effect.

cases.fault: Destination commits but local receipt persistence fails.
cases.expected: Record becomes/recovers as OutcomeUnknown; reconcile same operation and persist the authenticated outcome without a new logical effect.

cases.fault: Same idempotency key arrives after the terminal result is durably committed.
cases.expected: Return the existing stored terminal result; do not dispatch again.

cases.fault: Same key is used by a different authority domain.
cases.expected: Treat as a different namespaced key; never accept a receipt from the other domain.

cases.fault: Profile/agreement policy changes between reservation and dispatch.
cases.expected: Reevaluate current policy at dispatch boundary; stale policy binding must not authorize the effect.
